annotation.title_en: Launch of the National Guidelines on AI Governance and Ethics
named_instruments_referenced: Malaysia National Guidelines on AI Governance and Ethics (AIGE)
ASEAN Guide on AI Governance and Ethics
annotation.summary_en: Ministerial speech, published 20 September 2024 by Malaysia's Ministry of Digital, launching the National Guidelines on AI Governance and Ethics (AIGE). It presents the guidelines as strengthening existing cybersecurity and data protection law. It announces the National AI Office (NAIO), the "AI Untuk Rakyat" literacy programme, a planned data sharing bill and a proposed Data Commission.
key_provisions_or_claims: The AIGE guidelines are launched to promote safe, ethical and responsible AI use
An AI code of ethics is described as essential for building trust and digital resilience
AIGE complements the Cyber Security Act 2024 and the amended PDPA 2010; a draft Data Sharing Bill is due by year-end
The National AI Office (NAIO) will begin operating in November 2024 under MyDIGITAL Corporation
Proposes setting up a Malaysian Data Commission; AIGE is aligned with ASEAN initiatives
